# We Raise Tech

> We Raise Tech is a custom software development company that builds high-performance websites, custom web applications, scalable software, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, and e-commerce solutions for startups and growing businesses.

We Raise Tech specializes in React/Next.js frontends, Node.js/NestJS/Java/Python backends, and cloud-native deployments (AWS, Vercel, Docker). Typical engagements include new product builds, SaaS platforms, e-commerce storefronts, mobile apps, UI/UX design, and technical SEO. Projects are generally delivered in 2-8 weeks depending on scope, and clients retain full ownership of the source code once paid in full.

## Services

- [All Services](https://weraisetech.com/services): Overview of every service We Raise Tech offers.
- [Web Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/web-development): Custom websites engineered for performance, responsiveness, and SEO.
- [Full-Stack Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/full-stack): Modern frontend and backend systems built for scalability and maintainability.
- [E-Commerce Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/e-commerce): Scalable online stores designed to improve conversions.
- [SaaS Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/saas): Subscription-based software platforms for long-term growth.
- [UI/UX Design](https://weraisetech.com/services/ui-ux): User-focused digital experiences that improve engagement and conversions.
- [SEO Services](https://weraisetech.com/services/seo): Technical and on-page optimization that improves search visibility.
- [Shopify Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/shopify): Custom, fast, and scalable Shopify stores.
- [E-Commerce Optimization](https://weraisetech.com/services/ecommerce-optimization): Speed, performance, and conversion-rate improvements.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://weraisetech.com/services/maintenance-support): Ongoing monitoring, updates, and technical support.
- [Mobile App Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/mobile-app-development): High-performance iOS and Android applications.
- [Custom Software Development](https://weraisetech.com/services/custom-software-development): Tailor-made software that automates workflows and solves complex problems.
- [Solutions](https://weraisetech.com/solutions): Industry and use-case focused solution overviews.
